layout.emitted: .section .rodata; .align 3; per entry .half delta, .half 0, .word pfn; entry 0 = {-(subobject offset), 0, 0}; pure virtual slots name __pure_virtual; no terminator entry and no leading entry (vt.s; also r3/probe/vt2.s: virtual destructors, an inline-only class, a static object; the pinned gas 2.9.1 keeps .rodata 8-aligned and unpadded, vt2.o)
layout.install: constructors materialize the table (lui + addiu) and store it with sw into the object's vptr field (probe vt.s:56-66). Every pinned row carries its proven installs [store, context, function, member, origin, binding], replayed exactly on tools/mipsflow.py: the stored value is the table on every path, the store is entry-reachable, and the member is the receiver's (a0 on entry plus a constant) or bound to a call whose callee receives the same object and has its own receiver install at that member

generator_policy.slot_targets: matched in config/matches.json or classified handwritten in config/handwritten.json
generator_policy.note: Generator-side exclusions only. Replay re-derives layout, catalogued slot targets, start references, the proven vptr installs and the exact maximal extent from the original and the catalogue; whether replay must also re-check matched status is Main's/the reviewer's call.

open_residue.note: Left open on purpose (not missed): zero runs between two pinned tables (mostly exactly 8 bytes) are neither alignment (the tables are 8-aligned) nor table entries (the pinned cc1plus emits none and every install points at the header) and have no typed owner; other zero runs touching a pinned table have no positive type; excluded candidates fail the generator policy above or have no proven install; none is closed by geometry.
